headline: SEBI Examines Tighter Regulations for Margin Trading Facilities
summary: Securities and Exchange Board of India Chairman Tuhin Kanta Pandey announced that the market regulator is evaluating reforms to margin trading rules to manage leveraged retail trading risks.
why: SEBI sets regulatory requirements for the Indian capital markets. Restrictions on margin debt and broker financing directly affect market liquidity and speculative trading volumes.

impacts.name: BSE Sensex
impacts.why: Stricter margin rules could restrain retail leverage across Indian equity exchanges.
